name: Over Skull from Underroot
printed_text: You can banish this card from your hand or field; Special Summon 1 "Underroot" monster from your Deck. If this card or another "Underroot" monster is Normal or Special Summoned, while this card is face-up on your field: You can decrease this card level by up to 2, also you can treat it as a non-Tuner monster for the Synchro Summon of a "rroot" monster. If this card in your banishment is returned to the GY or hand: You can Special Summon this card. You can only use each effect of "Over Skull from Underroot" once per turn.
